== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[sacred beast|Sacred beasts]] are powerful animals that ascend after surviving for long periods, such as a century, by absorbing [[vital aura]] from their environment. This process allows them to cycle [[madra]] and advance in power, leaving behind [[Remnants]] similar to those left by humans. While some sacred beasts possess intelligence and the ability to speak, others are no more clever than common animals. Some legends suggest they can even adopt human forms. In terms of combat, these creatures are formidable; it typically requires practitioners at the [[Iron]] or [[Jade]] stages to face them. [[sacred beast|Sacred beasts]] exhibit various characteristics and roles within the world. Some live in the branches of [[ancestral trees]], defending them in exchange for [[spirit-fruit]], while others are massive enough to blot out the sky. Certain species, such as [[dragons]], possess high levels of intelligence and can utilize the arts of advanced [[sacred artists]]. There are also corrupted versions known as [[dreadbeasts]], which are warped and twisted by their own powers. While most sacred beasts follow a natural progression of refinement that makes them stronger and more beautiful, some can appear hideous or diseased. Additionally, [[sacred artists]] may form contracts with these creatures to use them as partners in battle.}}
